memos_so_far.headline: The same HERIZON-GEA-01 trial judged this morning under BeOne; a congress presentation of known results
reasoning: Source: Jazz's release (Benzinga 14:20 UTC): 'Jazz Pharmaceuticals Presents Data From Its Phase 3 HERIZON-GEA-01 Study Of Ziihera In Combination With Chemotherapy At ESMO Congress 2026'. The crew judged BeOne's release on the same trial at 10:21 ET ('Confirms Benefits Of TEVIMBRA + ZIIHERA').
What changed: the full data are presented at ESMO; the topline was public earlier. For Jazz ($13.9B), Ziihera matters more than for BeOne, but the market has had the topline for some time.
objections: Congress presentation of an already-reported Phase 3; no reaction.
